Do you want them changed?".`, a per-call fix line, the standing `For "no change": …` fix and the `--advisor-rebuttal` override; no ask reached INFRA-301 in either. proof.criterion: A3 — a `dispatch doc-edit` that adds an ask block whose recommendation is no change is refused, and the refusal names that block.

proof.command: dispatch doc-edit --issue INFRA-301 --artifact spec --ops-json '[{"op":"insert","after":"end","markdown":":::ask{urgency=\"med\"}…:::"}]' (run /tmp/t/docedit.txt); dispatch artifact --issue INFRA-301 --name tester-probe.md --content ':::ask{#retry urgency="med"}…:::' (run /tmp/t/upload.txt); dispatch doc-edit --issue INFRA-301 --artifact spec --ops-json-file /tmp/t/ops-big.json, a 38,720-byte markdown of six ask blocks whose first five are ~7.6 KiB of filler decisions and whose last is the no-change one (run /tmp/t/bigdoc.txt).

(2) The scenario rig needs docker and tmux, which a Legion pod has not, as plan Task 8 states.

Two observations for the reviewer, neither a defect found by driving the surface. (1) createDecisionRecorder reads `documents.get(sessionId)` before it calls `write()` (decision-record.ts:177-206), so two gated calls of one session that overlap would each upload a document and the session would own two; no record is lost, and the reader counts documents and sessions separately, so it shows. The gate refuses a dispatch write sent to the background with `&`, which closes the easy way to produce it, and thirteen runs across two concurrent batches produced one document per session. (2) `askgate-report.ts --dispatch-project ''` reaches Dispatch and dies with `DispatchServiceError: no route for GET /api/v1/projects/artifacts` (exit 1, nothing on stdout) where ask-census.ts refuses an empty --project by name; it refuses either way, so this is wording, not behaviour.

The fixture dispatch://INFRA-301 carries no open ask at the end of this round: every ask these runs opened (cc178c4a, 34b98a3e, 9a515a21, 1868bc8a, ff982326) was retracted with a reason naming this round and sjawhar/legion#2161, and no run wrote to its spec.
